problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 8 & 6 & -2 \\ 1 & 4 & 5 & -3 \\ -2 & -5 & -3 & 8 \\ -1 & -1 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -4 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & 3 & 7 & 2 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary column operations 

- ${C}_{2}:=…$
- ${C}_{3}:={C}_{3}-5{C}_{1}$
- ${C}_{4}:=…$

each of the form ${C}_{i}:={C}_{i}+k{C}_{1},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary column operations?
worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries to the right of ${a}_{21}=1$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary column operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 8 & 6 & -2 \\ 1 & 4 & 5 & -3 \\ -2 & -5 & -3 & 8 \\ -1 & -1 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-4{C}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 6 & -2 \\ 1 & 0 & 5 & -3 \\ -2 & 3 & -3 & 8 \\ -1 & 3 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{3}:={C}_{3}-5{C}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -4 & -2 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 & -3 \\ -2 & 3 & 7 & 8 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{4}:={C}_{4}+3{C}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -4 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & 3 & 7 & 2 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =B.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the corresponding elementary column operations are

$\,$ ${C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-4{C}_{1}\,$ and $\,{C}_{4}:={C}_{4}+3{C}_{1}.$
